summary: Baozun Inc. filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US foreign-private-issuer current report) with three Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns covering share repurchases. On September 28, 2026, the Cayman-incorporated, HK-listed issuer repurchased 43,665 Class A ordinary shares at USD 1 per share, held as treasury shares, reducing issued shares to 161,130,326 (0.03% of the prior balance) while treasury rose to 13,197,842. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; filings are routine buyback disclosures rather than a special situation. Watch ongoing repurchase pace and treasury-share overhang.
